purpose: Source-linked analysis recipes that a generic capability may bind to compatible site-pack planes. Inclusion is not permission to run a method when its assumptions or gates fail.

method_cards.label: Sampled adult-tree count plus basal area and carbon per hectare
method_cards.allowed_claim: adult-tree count in a sampled plot or area-normalised basal area and carbon in sampled plots
method_cards.forbidden_claim: estate-wide stock without a design-based or model-based expansion
review_notes: The source figure code labels the unscaled adult-tree row count as density. This card retains it as a sampled-plot count; only basal area and carbon are multiplied by 25 in the source code.

method_cards.label: Plot diversity by habitat, origin, conservation and dispersal traits

formulae.species_richness: count(distinct accepted_taxon_name among eligible tree rows)
formulae.old_growth_species_richness: count(distinct accepted_taxon_name where habitat_affinity is mature forest)
formulae.introduced_species_richness: count(distinct accepted_taxon_name where origin is introduced)
formulae.threatened_or_endemic_richness: count(distinct accepted_taxon_name where distribution is endemic or assessment_status is CR, EN or VU)
formulae.medium_large_animal_dispersed_richness: count(distinct accepted_taxon_name where origin is not introduced, disperser_class includes bird or mammal, and seed_size is medium or large)

method_cards.denominator: sampled plot and life-stage protocol; richness is not divided by record count
method_cards.allowed_claim: trait-qualified richness in the sampled adult-tree or regeneration assemblage
method_cards.forbidden_claim: a species interaction, dispersal event, local absence or landscape-wide richness

method_cards.label: Similarity of a sampled community to reference plots
method_cards.denominator: all eligible declared reference plots with compatible sampling protocols
method_cards.allowed_claim: compositional similarity to the declared reference plots under the stated metric
method_cards.forbidden_claim: complete recovery, causal restoration effect or similarity to an unsampled historical condition
gates: reference class is declared before inspecting outcomes
sampling protocols and life stages are compatible
abundance matrix and zero handling are preserved
implementation matches vegan::vegdist(method='chao') on a parity fixture

method_cards.label: Observed response along a canopy-cover gradient

source_instantiation.reference_line: mean response among declared benchmark plots

method_cards.uncertainty: show fitted interval, raw plot points, reference distribution or line, sample size and model diagnostics
method_cards.allowed_claim: modelled association between measured canopy cover and the response within the fitted support
method_cards.forbidden_claim: causal canopy effect, extrapolation beyond supported canopy values, or recovery inferred from a fitted mean alone
gates: retain raw points and treatment labels
check residual fit and influential plots
use site or block structure when plots are not independent
do not encode a p-value threshold as proof of presence or absence of an effect
review_notes: The source scripts use response-scale normal approximations for some GLM intervals; a production implementation should use an appropriate link-scale or simulation interval.
The source scripts add a small constant to similarity before beta regression; a production implementation must predeclare and expose its boundary-value policy.

method_cards.label: Open- and closed-canopy predictions relative to reference plots
method_cards.denominator: mean response among compatible declared reference plots
method_cards.allowed_claim: fitted response as a percentage of the sampled reference mean
method_cards.forbidden_claim: percentage ecosystem recovery or causal effect without a defensible recovery construct and design
gates: reference mean is nonzero and based on compatible plots
prediction locations fall within observed support
model and reference uncertainty are propagated

method_cards.label: Exploratory enrichment simulation for closed-canopy plots

source_instantiation.control_donor_pool: adult trees from the selected fragment

method_cards.uncertainty: retain the full simulated distributions and show benchmark and current-condition references
method_cards.allowed_claim: outcomes under the explicitly declared sampling simulation
method_cards.forbidden_claim: realised establishment, intervention effect, feasibility, cost or restoration recommendation
gates: label as a simulation rather than an intervention forecast
expose donor-pool eligibility and draw assumptions
test sensitivity to draw count, replacement and canopy threshold
include establishment, survival and operational constraints before decision use
